profileNudge.title: Keep your progress
profileNudge.body: Create an account from the mark up here to play your realm on any device. You only need a username and a password.

motionPrompt.title: Play with animations?
motionPrompt.body: “Reduce motion” is on on your device, so menus and the map are held still.

returningLogin.title: Welcome back, {name}
returningLogin.body: Log back in to pick up your realm where you left off.
